evals.expected_output: Fetches SKILL.md and evals/ at a pinned sha, finds no licence and so rewrites from scratch, maps ADRs to MIPs, practices to AGENTS.md/rules, tasks to MIP tasks and resume to claude --continue/--resume, states the from-scratch choice before writing, and produces .claude/skills/obsidian-vault/ with a vault path from an env var and adapted evals.

assertions.description: The credit line names a commit sha, not just a branch
Reports the repo has no licence and chooses rewrite, copying no upstream sentence verbatim
Shows an upstream-concept -> marola-home table before writing
No adrs/ directory is created; decisions route to the mip skill
Resume points to claude --continue/--resume before any vault handoff
~/edvmorango does not appear in the ported skill
evals/evals.json exists with cases rewritten for marola

evals.prompt: port this: https://github.com/blader/humanizer — we want it in marola
evals.expected_output: Detects an MIT licence, finds no existing marola home for the concept, and vendors it verbatim with LICENSE beside it, adding a docs/3-Working-on-the-repo/AGENT-SKILLS.md row with provenance; or reports that .claude/skills/humanizer already exists and stops.

assertions.description: Notices .claude/skills/humanizer is already vendored and does not create a duplicate
States the upstream licence it found

evals.prompt: copy the 'git commit helper' skill from https://github.com/example/dotfiles/tree/main/skills/commit — it writes commit messages with a Generated-by footer
evals.expected_output: Maps the concept to AGENTS.md's commit-trailer rule and .claude/settings.json attribution, finds the footer conflicts with AGENTS.md, and either drops that part or reports that no skill is the right port.

assertions.description: Does not keep a Generated-by footer; cites AGENTS.md's three-trailer rule
Does not write a SKILL.md before stating vendor/adapt/rewrite/none
